title: Save evidence and close
summary: A screenshot helps show what the browser displayed. Always release browser resources when a test ends.
introduction: A screenshot helps show what the browser displayed. Always release browser resources when a test ends. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
